target.title: fix(secrets): keep startup alive when TTS SecretRefs are missing
target.body:
Closes #101204

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users who configured an optional TTS provider API key via SecretRef could have the entire Gateway fail to start when that provider key was missing or empty. In the reported case, a missing `ELEVENLABS_API_KEY` disabled Gateway startup instead of only disabling ElevenLabs speech synthesis.

## Why This Change Was Made

The change adds an explicit optional-secret path to the runtime secrets materialization flow and uses it only for built-in TTS provider API-key assignments. Required startup credentials still fail closed: gateway auth, model provider keys, plugin credentials, channel tokens, and other required SecretRefs continue to abort startup when unavailable.

When an optional TTS SecretRef is unavailable, OpenClaw now:

- leaves the affected provider key unconfigured in the resolved runtime config;
- emits a structured `SECRETS_REF_UNAVAILABLE_OPTIONAL` warning with the path and resolver error;
- lets Gateway startup and unrelated runtime capabilities continue;
- keeps TTS request failures localized to the selected provider's missing-key error.

## User Impact

Operators can keep optional ElevenLabs or other built-in TTS SecretRefs in config without risking a full Gateway outage when that one optional provider key is temporarily absent. Core chat, Gateway auth, other tools, and unrelated plugins remain protected by the existing fail-fast behavior for required credentials.

## Evidence

Targeted coverage added in this PR:

- `src/secrets/runtime.test.ts`
  - missing `messages.tts.providers.elevenlabs.apiKey` SecretRef degrades to a warning and leaves the provider key unset;
  - missing required `gateway.auth.token` SecretRef still fails startup preflight.
- `src/secrets/runtime-config-collectors-tts.test.ts`
  - TTS provider API-key assignments are marked optional;
  - inactive TTS surfaces still skip resolution and emit inactive-surface warnings.
- `src/secrets/runtime-discord-surface.test.ts`
  - enabled Discord account voice/TTS overrides degrade when a nested TTS provider SecretRef is unavailable, without resolving inactive base-channel TTS refs.
- `src/gateway/server-startup-config.secrets.test.ts`
  - startup activation accepts optional TTS SecretRef warnings without entering the degraded reload state.
- `src/gateway/server-methods/tts.test.ts`
  - TTS synthesis failures caused by missing provider credentials are returned as localized `UNAVAILABLE` TTS errors.

- `git diff --check` passed.
